newsitem.title: JAPAN: Pacific Metals ferronickel output on target.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Metals ferronickel output on target.

text.p: Pacific Metals Co is on target to produce 39,000 tonnes of ferronickel in the fiscal year to March 1997, a company official said on Wednesday.

Confirming a report in a Japanese trade publication in the morning, he said output was cut from July through September to 2,800 tonnes per month from normal levels of above 3,000 tonnes per month, due to scheduled repairs to one of its furnaces.
"In October we will return to our original (output level) of more than 3,000 tonnes," the official said.
